questions.question: In the 2022-23 academic year, what was the total tuition, fees, room, and board in current dollars charged by 4-year public institutions?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_tuition_fees_room_board.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 330.10', header=None)
pub_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'public institutions'].index[0]
next_idx = df.loc[pub_idx + 1:][df.loc[pub_idx + 1:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Private|Nonprofit|For-profit|NOTE', regex=True)].index[0]
pub_df = df.loc[pub_idx + 1:next_idx - 1]
row_2022 = pub_df[pub_df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == '2022-23']
result = float(row_2022.iloc[0, 2])

questions.question: For the 2022-23 school year, did 4-year private nonprofit colleges have a higher average tuition and required fees than 4-year private for-profit colleges in current dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_tuition_fees_room_board.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 330.10', header=None)
nonprofit_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'nonprofit'].index[0]
forprofit_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'for-profit'].index[0]

nonprofit_row = df.loc[nonprofit_idx:forprofit_idx][df.loc[nonprofit_idx:forprofit_idx, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == '2022-23']
forprofit_row = df.loc[forprofit_idx:][df.loc[forprofit_idx:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == '2022-23']

nonprofit_val = float(nonprofit_row.iloc[0, 5])
forprofit_val = float(forprofit_row.iloc[0, 5])

result = 'yes' if nonprofit_val > forprofit_val else 'no'

questions.question: Across all institutions, in which academic year between 2015-16 and 2022-23 was the average total tuition, fees, room, and board in constant 2022-23 dollars the highest?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_tuition_fees_room_board.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 330.10', header=None)
all_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'all institutions'].index[0]
pub_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'public institutions'].index[0]
sub = df.loc[all_idx + 1:pub_idx - 1].copy()
years = ['2015-16', '2016-17', '2017-18', '2018-19', '2019-20', '2020-21', '2021-22', '2022-23']
sub = sub[sub[0].astype(str).str.strip().isin(years)]
sub[13] = pd.to_numeric(sub[13])
max_row = sub.loc[sub[13].idxmax()]
result = str(max_row[0]).strip()

questions.question: From 2000-01 through 2022-23, how many academic years saw the constant 2022-23 dollar total tuition, fees, room, and board for 4-year programs across all institutions exceed $30,000?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_tuition_fees_room_board.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 330.10', header=None)
all_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'all institutions'].index[0]
pub_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'public institutions'].index[0]
sub = df.loc[all_idx + 1:pub_idx - 1].copy()
sub[0] = sub[0].astype(str).str.strip()
start_idx = sub[sub[0] == '2000-01'].index[0]
end_idx = sub[sub[0] == '2022-23'].index[0]
sub = sub.loc[start_idx:end_idx]
sub[14] = pd.to_numeric(sub[14])
result = int((sub[14] > 30000).sum())

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_tuition_fees_room_board.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 330.10', header=None)

# All institutions: r6 to r62
# Constant 2022-23 dollars -> Total tuition, fees, room, board -> 4-year is Col O (index 14)
all_inst_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'All institutions'].index[0]
public_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Public institutions')].index[0]

sub_df = df.iloc[all_inst_idx+1:public_idx].copy()
sub_df['year'] = sub_df[0].astype(str).str.strip()

# Filter for 2000-01 through 2022-23
# Extract start year
sub_df = sub_df[sub_df['year'].str.match(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}')]
sub_df['start_year'] = sub_df['year'].apply(lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]))
sub_df = sub_df[(sub_df['start_year'] >= 2000) & (sub_df['start_year'] <= 2022)]

sub_df[14] = pd.to_numeric(sub_df[14])
result = int((sub_df[14] > 30000).sum())
